depth.why: roundToCents changes results on half-cent ties for 2 in-repo callers and 1 external consumer, and no test covers ties.

questions.prompt: roundToCents now uses banker's rounding. What happens to an amount that lands exactly on half a cent, such as 2.345?

choices.text: It rounds up to 2.35, as before.
choices.explain: That was the old half-away-from-zero behaviour; ties now go to the even cent.

choices.text: It rounds to the even cent, 2.34.
choices.explain: Right: ties go to the even neighbour, so 2.345 becomes 2.34 and 2.355 becomes 2.36.

choices.text: It is truncated to 2.34 whatever the digit.
choices.explain: Only exact ties change; 2.346 still rounds up to 2.35.

questions.hint: Which of the two neighbouring cents, 2.34 or 2.35, is even?

questions.prompt: Which rounding rule does roundToCents apply to exact ties now, and which line decides it?
questions.reference: Ties go to the even cent (half-even, banker's rounding). Line 10 detects an exact tie within 1e-9 and line 11 picks the even neighbour; everything else still goes through Math.round.
questions.hint: Look at the branch that only runs when the fraction is exactly 0.5: what does it return for an odd floor?

questions.prompt: No test covers half-cent ties. Should this PR add one before it merges?

choices.text: Yes: ask for a test of exact ties.
choices.explain: Ties are the only inputs whose result changed, so a test pins the new behaviour down.

comment.body: Could you add a test for exact half-cent ties (for example 2.345 -> 2.34 and 2.355 -> 2.36)? They're the only inputs whose result changes, and nothing covers them yet.

choices.text: No: the change is small enough without one.
choices.explain: Then the new behaviour is only documented by the doc comment.

questions.prompt: Nothing in checkout changed. Can an order total still come out different after this PR?

choices.explain: orderTotal rounds through roundToCents, so it inherits the new rule.

choices.text: Yes, by a cent when the taxed subtotal lands exactly on a half cent.
choices.explain: Right: orderTotal rounds once at the end with roundToCents.

questions.hint: Where does orderTotal get its rounding from?
